failingTests: task 1: apiBaseUrl reads VITE_API_URL and rejects a missing address
task 2: trailsUrl builds the trails endpoint with encoded query filters
task 3: createTrailRequest posts JSON with the right method, header and body
task 4: problemMessage maps ProblemDetail responses to learner-facing text
task 5: loadTrails distinguishes network failure, HTTP error and success
task 6: applyResult updates the page model without mutating the old one
task 7: your format-distance.test.mjs exists and uses test, expect, toBe and toEqual

cleanup.notes: Setup (npm ci in starter/) creates starter/node_modules, which holds the pinned Vitest 4.1.12 test runner; Vitest keeps its temporary transform cache inside starter/node_modules too. Cleanup deletes starter/node_modules; the tests create nothing else and make no network requests: every fetch in the lab is a fake function supplied by the public tests. Resetting the learner's work means copying starter/api.mjs back from a fresh copy of the lab and deleting the learner-created starter/format-distance.test.mjs. The expected output file writes the lab path, start time and durations as placeholders; its 9-test total assumes the exactly-two tests Task 7 requires. The 68-minute cap is the S27 lab-block planning allowance, not a measured learner pilot.
